market_preliminary_steer: HubSpot best capability-per-euro for ad agency; Zoho budget hedge; Salesforce only if enterprise-client procurement demands it
market_assumptions: Knowledge cutoff Jan 2026, no web access; list prices ballpark, annual billing ex-VAT; all 40 staff seated

risk_eu_residency.salesforce: Hyperforce EU (Frankfurt/Paris); optional EU Operating Zone at extra cost
risk_eu_residency.hubspot: EU data centre (Frankfurt, AWS eu-central-1); region fixed at portal creation
risk_eu_residency.zoho: EU data centres (Amsterdam region); Indian parent, transfer analysis to India

risk_top_severity_items: Joint-controller GDPR exposure from ad-audience syncs (all vendors, sev 4)
Salesforce config lock-in and exit cost (sev 4)
Salesforce adoption failure among non-sales staff (sev 4)

risk_register.risk: US CLOUD Act / transfer challenge to EU data
risk_register.mitigation: EU residency + SCCs + transfer impact assessment; minimise sensitive data in CRM

risk_register.risk: EU region fixed at signup; later change is a re-migration
risk_register.mitigation: Select EU data centre at portal creation
SCCs, TIA, confirm EU DC and EU-only support access in DPA
Consent/LIA review before enabling Meta/Google audience sync; document in RoPA
Keep automations in middleware; quarterly exports; avoid multi-year terms

risk_register.risk: Marketing-asset lock-in and contact-tier price creep
risk_register.mitigation: Cap synced contacts; archive cold contacts; negotiate tiers at renewal

risk_register.risk: Suite coupling via Zoho One spreads lock-in beyond CRM
risk_register.mitigation: Adopt CRM only; evaluate suite modules individually
Phased rollout, named admin, role-trimmed UI; prefer Pro Suite tier

risk_register.risk: Hidden year-1 costs (admin FTE, support uplift, add-ons)
risk_register.mitigation: Budget 1.5-2x licence year 1; fixed-price implementation partner
Validate Professional-tier permission model in trial before contract

risk_register.risk: Weak EU support/partner bench delays resolution
risk_register.mitigation: Premium support tier + named EU partner on retainer
Pre-migration dedup/cleanse sprint; migrate in waves with validation gates

risk_steer: Risk profile supports market steer: HubSpot risks are mitigable by contract/config; Salesforce risks are structural at 40 seats; Zoho acceptable only with paid support and middleware budget
risk_assumptions: Knowledge-only, Jan 2026 cutoff; Brightline assumed controller migrating from spreadsheets/legacy; residency options and contract norms must be verified in DPA/order form
final_recommendation: HubSpot (Sales Hub Professional + Marketing Hub Professional), EU data centre (Frankfurt) selected at portal creation, annual billing; Zoho rejected as budget hedge (ad-ops and EU support gaps), Salesforce rejected as structurally over-risked at 40 seats (1.5-2.0x hidden costs, adoption, lock-in)

rollout_plan.name: Foundation & pilot
rollout_plan.actions: EU data centre portal creation (region fixed day one); DPA/SCCs/TIA; validate Pro-tier permissions in trial pre-contract; data dedup/cleanse sprint; wave migration with validation gates; 10-user sales/account pilot; annual-term and tier negotiation

rollout_plan.name: Sales rollout & ad-ops integration
rollout_plan.actions: All client-facing staff onboarded; consent/LIA review + RoPA documentation BEFORE enabling Meta/Google audience sync; lead-ad capture and ad-spend attribution live; middleware for GA4/programmatic kept outside vendor-native automation; cap/archive cold contacts

rollout_plan.name: Agency-wide adoption & governance
rollout_plan.actions: Creatives/ops on lightweight or free seats (realise ~EUR 15-20k seat saving); Marketing Hub campaigns and dashboards; role-based training; quarterly full data exports instituted; renewal calendar for contact tiers; week-12 governance review vs adoption KPIs

executive_summary: Adopt HubSpot (Sales Hub Pro + Marketing Hub Pro, EU-hosted) at an estimated year-1 total of ~EUR 68,000 (1.28x licence, within the risk analyst's 1.2-1.5x band). HubSpot wins on capability-per-euro for an ad agency: native Meta/Google Ads integration, lowest adoption risk for a 40-person mixed creative/sales team, Dublin EMEA support, and residual risks mitigable by contract/config. Salesforce is disqualified at this headcount (all-in year 1 EUR 120-160k, severity-4 structural risks); Zoho's ~EUR 34k saving is eroded by premium support, middleware, and weak EU partner bench. Rollout in 3 phases over 12 weeks, gating ad-audience syncs behind a documented consent/LIA review (the top cross-vendor GDPR risk). All figures knowledge-based (Jan 2026 cutoff); verify against live quotes and DPA before signature.
lead_partner_weighing: Specialists agreed on direction; tensions resolved as follows: ad-ops integration kept as core selection driver but sequenced behind consent review per risk analyst; costed conservatively on full 40 paid seats with the ~25-seat model held as upside; hidden-cost multipliers weighted over sticker price; Zoho's price advantage judged insufficient against integration fit and support proximity for an agency dependent on campaign ops
